heroTitle: Highest Silver Grades in the World
heroDescription: 89,853 g/t silver discovery expanding toward 30-100 million ounces. Operating North America's only permitted high-grade processor capable of producing 1 million oz silver annually.
banner: 89,853 g/t Silver • 24 tonne/day gravity plant • Federal innovation funding
aboutTitle: Castle Discovery + TTL Processing = Production-Ready Infrastructure
aboutDescription: Nord combines world-class exploration at Castle East—where drilling targets 30-100 million ounces, with the district's only operating processing facility. Our 20,000 sq ft TTL plant processes high-grade material into silver doré while advancing Re-2Ox technology for complex concentrates. This dual approach funds continued exploration through processing revenue while expanding the silver resource.
infoBlock1Note: 7.5M oz resource expanding through 60,000m drilling. Underground access to broken ore plus high-grade tailings.
infoBlock2Note: Operating 24 tonne/day gravity plant. Bullion furnace capacity: 1M+ oz silver annually. Former Ontario government facility.
infoBlock3Note: MICA-funded pilot addressing arsenic-led penalty elements. SGS advancing toward commercial deployment.
infoBlock4Note: Multiple bonanza-grade intersections including 89,853 g/t, 70,380 g/t, and 50,583 g/t silver confirm potential for district-scale discovery at Castle East.
silverTitle: Building the Next Major Silver Resource
silverDescription: Starting from 7.5 million ounces at 8,582 g/t, our ongoing drill program targets 30-100 million ounces. These exceptional grades, 27 times industry average, transform project economics while TTL processing generates near-term cash flow.
temiskamingTitle: TTL: From Government Lab to Production Hub
temiskamingDescription: Acquired in 2020, our Temiskaming Testing Labs served the district for decades, pouring millions of ounces for Agnico and Teck. Now upgraded with 20 tonne/hour crushing, 24 tonne/day gravity circuits, and 6,000 assay/month analytical capacity, TTL processes both our material and third-party feeds while advancing the Re-2Ox pilot.
re2OxTitle: Re-2Ox: Leading the Solution for Penalty Elements
re2OxDescription: Arsenic heads the list of penalty elements limiting global processing options, followed by antimony, bismuth, and others. Our hydrometallurgical process handles them all, with SGS validation showing >99% stabilization. As smelter capacity shrinks, field-deployable Re-2Ox units offer mine-site solutions.
re2OxInfo1Note: Arsenic-led suite including Sb, Bi, Cd, Pb. Containerized units deploy where concentrates are produced.
re2OxInfo2Note: 22.6% battery-grade cobalt sulfate from Castle concentrates. 99% Co recovery, 81% Ni recovery.
